story.text: 함덕 해변 근처 캠핑장에 도착하자, 용우는 망설임 없이 능숙한 손놀림으로 텐트를 치기 시작했다.
story.reading: ham-deok hae-byeon geun-cheo kaem-ping-jang-e do-chak-ha-ja, yong-u-neun mang-seol-im eob-si neung-suk-han son-nol-lim-eu-ro ten-teu-reul chi-gi si-jak-haet-da.
story.en: The moment we arrived at the campground near Hamdeok Beach, Yongwoo started pitching the tent with skilled, unhesitating hands.

story.text: 도와준답시고 나선 나는 오히려 폴대를 반대로 꽂는 실수를 했다. '가만있어라, 그냥.' 핀잔을 주면서도 용우는 웃음을 참는 눈치였다.
story.reading: do-wa-jun-dap-si-go na-seon na-neun o-hi-ryeo pol-dae-reul ban-dae-ro kkoj-neun sil-su-reul haet-da. ga-man-it-eo-ra, geu-nyang. pin-jan-eul ju-myeon-seo-do yong-u-neun us-eum-eul cham-neun nun-chi-yeot-da.
story.en: Trying to help, I only managed to plant a pole in backward. 'Just stay still.' Even as he scolded me, Yongwoo looked like he was holding back a laugh.

story.text: 장작을 패고 모닥불을 피우는 손길에는 군더더기가 없었다. 순식간에 타오르는 불꽃을 보며 나는 감탄할 수밖에 없었다.
story.reading: jang-jag-eul pae-go mo-dak-bul-eul pi-u-neun son-gil-e-neun gun-deo-deo-gi-ga eob-seot-da. sun-sik-gan-e ta-o-reu-neun bul-kkoch-eul bo-myeo na-neun gam-tan-hal su-bakk-e eob-seot-da.
story.en: The way he split firewood and started the bonfire had no wasted motion at all. Watching the flames leap up in an instant, I couldn't help but be impressed.

story.text: 우리는 모닥불 앞에 나란히 앉아 말없이 불멍을 즐겼다. 타닥타닥 장작 타는 소리만이 조용히 밤공기를 채웠다.
story.reading: u-ri-neun mo-dak-bul ap-e na-ran-hi anj-a mal-eop-si bul-meong-eul jeul-gyeot-da. ta-dak-ta-dak jang-jak ta-neun so-ri-man-i jo-yong-hi bam-gong-gi-reul chae-wot-da.
story.en: We sat side by side in front of the fire, quietly zoning out to the flames without a word. Only the crackling of burning wood quietly filled the night air.

story.text: 고개를 들자 밤하늘 가득 별이 쏟아질 듯 펼쳐져 있었다. 굳이 말을 하지 않아도 이 시간이 편안하게 느껴졌다.
story.reading: go-gae-reul deul-ja bam-ha-neul ga-deuk byeol-i ssod-a-jil deut pyeol-chyeo-jyeo iss-eot-da. gud-i mal-eul ha-ji anh-a-do i si-gan-i pyeon-an-ha-ge neu-kkyeo-jyeot-da.
story.en: Looking up, the night sky stretched out full of stars, as if they might come pouring down. I didn't need to say anything for this moment to feel comfortable.

story.text: '어릴 때는 이런 불 보는 시간도 없었다.' 용우가 불빛에 비친 얼굴로 조용히 입을 열었다. '태권도 훈련 끝나면 쓰러져 자기 바빴으니까.'
story.reading: eo-ril ttae-neun i-reon bul bo-neun si-gan-do eob-seot-da. yong-u-ga bul-bit-e bi-chin eol-gul-lo jo-yong-hi ib-eul yeol-eot-da. tae-kwon-do hun-lyeon kkeut-na-myeon sseu-reo-jyeo ja-gi ba-ppass-eu-ni-kka.
story.en: 'As a kid, I never even had time to sit and watch a fire like this.' Yongwoo spoke quietly, his face lit by the flames. 'The moment taekwondo training ended, I was too busy collapsing into sleep.'

story.text: 밤이 깊어 불씨를 정리하며 하루를 마무리했다. '오늘처럼 아무것도 안 하고 편하게 보낸 날도 오랜만이다.' 낮게 웃는 용우의 목소리가 어둠 속에서 따뜻하게 울렸다.
story.reading: bam-i gip-eo bul-ssi-reul jeong-ni-ha-myeo ha-ru-reul ma-mu-ri-haet-da. o-neul-cheo-reom a-mu-geot-do an ha-go pyeon-ha-ge bo-naen nal-do o-raen-man-i-da. naj-ge us-neun yong-u-ui mok-so-ri-ga eo-dum sog-e-seo tta-tteut-ha-ge ul-lyeot-da.
story.en: As night deepened, we wrapped up the day by tending to the dying embers. 'It's been a while since I had a day this relaxed, doing absolutely nothing.' Yongwoo's low laugh echoed warmly through the darkness.

words.example_en: We pitched a tent at the campground.
We split firewood and lit a bonfire.
There wasn't a single wasted motion in his movements.

words.meaning: staring blankly at a fire, zoning out to the flames
words.example_en: We enjoyed zoning out in front of the campfire.
The night air was cool and refreshing.

sentences.en: He split firewood and started a bonfire.
There was absolutely no wasted motion in his hands.

sentences.ko: 우리는 모닥불 앞에서 조용히 불멍을 즐겼다.
sentences.reading: u-ri-neun mo-dak-bul ap-e-seo jo-yong-hi bul-meong-eul jeul-gyeot-da
sentences.en: We quietly enjoyed staring at the campfire together.
The cool night air felt refreshing instead of cold.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 내가 도와줄게. 이거 어떻게 하는 거야?
turns.reading: nae-ga do-wa-jul-ge. i-geo eo-tteo-ke ha-neun geo-ya?
turns.en: I'll help you. How do you do this part?

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.en: Just stay still. You put the pole in backward.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 아, 미안. 나 이런 거 진짜 처음이라.
turns.reading: a, mi-an. na i-reon geo jin-jja cheo-eum-i-ra.
turns.en: Ah, sorry. This is really my first time doing this.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.en: It's fine, just watch. It'll be done in no time.

dialogues.question: 텐트를 치다 실수한 손님에게 용우가 보인 태도로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What best describes Yongwoo's attitude toward the passenger's mistake while pitching the tent?
dialogues.correct_answer: 짜증 내지 않고 배려하며 직접 마무리해 주었다
options: 짜증 내지 않고 배려하며 직접 마무리해 주었다
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 핀잔을 주는 척했지만 짜증 내지 않고, 배려하는 마음으로 직접 텐트 치는 일을 마무리해 주었습니다.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: What are you thinking about? You look relaxed.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.text: 그냥, 어릴 때 생각이 좀 났다. 태권도 훈련 끝나면 쓰러져 자기 바빴으니까.
turns.reading: geu-nyang, eo-ril ttae saeng-gag-i jom nat-da. tae-kwon-do hun-lyeon kkeut-na-myeon sseu-reo-jyeo ja-gi ba-ppass-eu-ni-kka.
turns.en: Just thinking about when I was a kid. Once taekwondo training ended, I was too busy collapsing into sleep.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: It was that hard? I'm hearing this for the first time.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.text: …오늘처럼 아무것도 안 하고 편하게 보낸 날도 오랜만이라 그런가 보다.
turns.reading: o-neul-cheo-reom a-mu-geot-do an ha-go pyeon-ha-ge bo-naen nal-do o-raen-man-i-ra geu-reon-ga bo-da.
turns.en: ...I guess it's because it's been a while since I had a day this relaxed, doing nothing like today.

dialogues.question: 용우가 불멍을 하며 어릴 적 이야기를 꺼낸 이유로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What best explains why Yongwoo brought up his childhood while staring at the fire?
dialogues.correct_answer: 편안한 분위기 속에서 자연스럽게 마음이 열렸다
options: 편안한 분위기 속에서 자연스럽게 마음이 열렸다
화제를 돌려 다른 이야기를 피하려는 것이다
그냥 심심해서 아무 말이나 한 것이다
dialogues.explanation: 모닥불 앞의 편안한 분위기 속에서 용우는 자연스럽게 마음을 열고 평소 잘 하지 않던 어릴 적 이야기를 꺼냈습니다.
